migration.note: The stored text is an integrity guard followed by the candidate. The guard (a DO block placed before the candidate's own begin) hashed substr(current_query(), marker, 61583) and refused unless it equalled the candidate's sha256; the connector appends its own comment lines after the text, so only that fixed-length span is hashed. The database-computed sha256 of the same span in the stored row equals the candidate's trimmed sha256, i.e. the candidate is stored byte for byte.
